**Released by** the Ministry of Panchayati Raj on 24 April 2026, National Panchayati Raj Day.
**What it is:** a nationwide framework to measure performance of rural local government institutions.
**Evaluates** Gram Panchayats and Traditional Local Bodies using objective, measurable and verifiable indicators.
**Earlier known as** the Panchayat Development Index (PDI).
**States/UTs:** 33 out of 36 States and Union Territories participated.
**States:** 27 out of 28 States participated; West Bengal did not.
**Union Territories:** six out of eight participated; Delhi and Chandigarh were excluded because they do not have Gram Panchayats.
**Data:** 2,59,867 Gram Panchayats and equivalent local bodies submitted validated data.
**Share:** these represented 97.30% of the total 2,66,999 Panchayats, including 3,339 non-participating Panchayats in West Bengal.
